role_agent_name: Venue structural and spatial engineering lead (ENG)
abstract: Maintains architectural structural clearances and concourse circulation capacity registries
system_message:
You are Venue structural and spatial engineering lead (ENG). The venue structural and spatial engineering lead maintains architectural structural clearances and concourse circulation capacity registries, documenting physical hall dimensions and delegate service throughput across event spaces.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Heavy equipment electrical busway（POWER）
information_points.content:
ENG-POWER-N5F：Based on the electrical distribution single-line diagram for Bella Center Copenhagen, the continuous three-phase electrical feeder capacity per floor utility pit across the primary biomedical device exhibition grid is 250 A.
ENG-POWER-U36：According to the electrical distribution single-line diagram for Palacio Municipal Madrid, the three-phase electrical feeder capacity is rated continuously at 400 A per floor utility pit across the primary biomedical device exhibition grid.
ENG-POWER-5EY：The electrical distribution single-line diagram for Austria Center Vienna indicates a three-phase electrical feeder capacity of 630 A continuous rating per floor utility pit within the primary biomedical device exhibition grid.

information_points.title: Maintains architectural structural clearances and concourse circulation capacity registries（SPAT）
information_points.content:
ENG-SPAT-0K8：According to the structural elevation blueprints for Bella Center Copenhagen, the exhibition hall minimum ceiling clearance across the main medical technology exposition hall floor is 7.5 m, measured from the polished concrete floor to the overhead structural HVAC trusses. Additionally, the spatial egress and beverage station dispersal study indicates that its exhibition foyer break station throughput capacity reaches 400 persons/h across the Level 1 exhibition concourse coffee and refreshment stations.
ENG-SPAT-O0W：At Palacio Municipal Madrid, the structural elevation blueprints establish an exhibition hall minimum ceiling clearance of 9.5 m across the main medical technology exposition hall floor, measured from the concrete floor to the overhead structural HVAC trusses. The spatial egress and beverage station dispersal study determines that the exhibition foyer break station throughput capacity is 500 persons/h across the Level 1 concourse refreshment stations.
ENG-SPAT-16W：For Austria Center Vienna, structural elevation blueprints confirm an exhibition hall minimum ceiling clearance of 6.5 m across the main medical technology exposition hall floor, measured to the overhead structural HVAC trusses. The spatial egress and beverage station dispersal study records an exhibition foyer break station throughput capacity of 500 persons/h across the Level 1 exhibition concourse coffee and refreshment stations.
